data.revised_prompt: Create a game-ready 4 by 4 atlas of modular top-down greenhouse garden battlefield tiles. Each quadrant is a distinct seamless tile with consistent orthographic top-down style and no perspective. Row 1: dark rich soil with blue-green moss, damp soil with small leaves, dark soil with subtle cyan bioluminescent veins, wet soil with tiny stones. Row 2: stone path segment, cyan mossy stone border, broken greenhouse garden wall, warm amber entrance threshold. Row 3: open soil variants with very low contrast for gameplay readability. Row 4: subtle garden floor variants. No text, no UI, no characters, no grid lines, no black borders, no transparency, full-bleed square tiles.
